claim: the longest-running of Chile's icon Cabernets (stem); Chile's whole icon category began with it, and every other major producer answered within a decade (explanation)
because: Errázuriz's Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve, a Cabernet-led icon, has a first vintage in 1983 or 1984 by different accounts (World of Fine Wine tasted the 1984 as the first vintage). Either way it came before Don Melchor's 1987. World of Fine Wine dates Chile's first luxury wines to the 1980s and credits Chadwick's Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve, alongside Don Melchor and Casa Real. Don Melchor did not start the category alone, and it is not the longest-running. Errázuriz is also one of the options, which makes the false framing worse. The key (Concha y Toro) stands.
fix: Stem: 'Don Melchor, first bottled in 1987 from a single estate in Puente Alto and one of Chile's first icon Cabernets, belongs to which producer?' Explanation: replace the last sentence with 'With Errázuriz's Don Maximiano and Santa Rita's Casa Real, it led the first generation of Chilean icon reds.'
